joshua.20.p1.b1.text: Tell the Israelites to designate the cities of refuge …

joshua.20.p1.b2.text: so that anyone who kills another unintentionally or accidentally may flee there.

joshua.20.p1.b3.text: … stands at the entrance of the city gate, and states his case before its elders, they are to bring him into the city …

joshua.20.p1.b4.text: Now if the avenger of blood pursues him, they must not surrender the manslayer into his hand, because that man killed his neighbor accidentally without prior malice.

joshua.20.p2.b1.text: … until the death of the high priest serving at that time. Then the manslayer may return to his own home in the city from which he fled.

joshua.20.p2.b2.text: So they set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.

joshua.20.p2.b3.text: These are the cities appointed for all the Israelites and foreigners among them, so that anyone who kills a person unintentionally may flee there and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood …
